findings.title: Base-case FY27E/FY28E EPS is roughly flat vs FY26, well below management's bullish framing
findings.detail: Base-case build: revenue INR 19,399cr (FY27E, +8.7% YoY) / INR 19,156cr (FY28E, -1.3% YoY); EBITDA margin fades from FY26's cyclical-peak 48.27% to 44.5% (FY27E) / 43.0% (FY28E); PAT INR 6,016cr / 5,703cr; EPS INR 32.76 / 31.05. Base-case 2yr EPS CAGR (FY26->FY28E) = -0.98%. This reflects (a) metal/alumina prices normalizing off cyclical highs per independent World Bank/Platts anchors rather than management's own guidance, and (b) the 5th-stream alumina refinery ramp being probability-weighted at 0.40/0.55 (not 1.0) given its low guidance credibility and DR1b's unconfirmed-commissioning finding as of Jul-2026.

findings.title: 5th-stream/Pottangi volume upside is the single largest swing factor between scenarios
findings.detail: Bull case (5th-stream at 100% of guided nameplate, no probability discount; metal $3,200/t, alumina $340/t; margin holds 48-49%) produces FY27E/FY28E EPS of INR 38.11/42.42 and a +15.74% 2yr EPS CAGR. Bear case (zero incremental 5th-stream/Pottangi volume in the horizon, consistent with the ~18-month historical guidance-slip pattern; metal toward Goldman Sachs' ~$2,400/t CY2027 bear case; alumina $260-280/t on deepening Indonesian oversupply; margin compresses to 37-39%; finance cost +30-50% on continued capex-overrun-driven borrowing) produces EPS of INR 24.04/21.26 and a -18.05% 2yr EPS CAGR. The base/bull/bear spread (-0.98% / +15.74% / -18.05%) is driven primarily by the probability weight applied to this one capacity lever, not by price assumptions alone.

findings.title: Variant view: estimates are more conservative than management's implicit guidance flow-through
findings.detail: Management's own FY27 price guidance (aluminium $3,000-3,100/t, alumina $300-310/t) sits within/near the independent forecast band used here and is not itself the point of divergence. The key divergence is volume: guidance-analyst scored the 5th-stream/Pottangi timeline as low-credibility (guided volume cut 500kt->300kt->200kt within FY26 alone) and DR1b's Jul-2026 follow-up found commissioning still unconfirmed past the guided Jun-2026 date (commissioning-support tender still pre-bid as of 01-Jul-2026). A naive 100%-guidance-flow-through model would sit closer to our bull case (+15.7% 2yr EPS CAGR); the base case instead sits at -0.98%, reflecting the hard rule that low-credibility guidance never becomes the base case.

findings.title: No confirmed working-capital red flag applies as an estimates drag; capex-overrun pattern applied instead
findings.detail: state/red_flags.json contains no confirmed working-capital deterioration: RF-001 (other income/CFO ratio) is adjudicated disclosed/medium/benign (cyclical-denominator effect); RF-002/RF-003 (DSO increases) are dismissed/low/immaterial (day-count moves on a near-zero receivables base); RF-MERGE-01 is dismissed as a data-quality issue. This is explicitly checked and closed as 'not applicable' rather than silently omitted. In its place, the one genuinely confirmed adverse pattern in the ledger -- capex-execution overruns of ~20% historically (F-FUND-04) -- is built into the estimates as an upward bias on the capex/D&A/finance-cost lines in both estimate years, functioning as the estimates-drag role the orchestrator's instruction anticipated.

findings.title: Six mandatory sanity gates run; all pass or show an expected, disclosed divergence
findings.detail: (1) Capex->gross block->asset turns: 5th-stream capex capitalizes ahead of full-ramp revenue contribution, consistent with F-FUND-03's flagged dilutive-ROCE window -- PASS (expected divergence, disclosed). (2) EPS growth vs PAT growth: identical in both years (no dilution assumed) -- PASS. (3) Margin vs bridge vs band: FY27E/FY28E margins (44.5%/43.0%) sit within the 5-year historical band (~24.9% trough to ~48.3% peak) and track the guidance ledger's Medium-Low margin-bridge achievability score -- PASS. (4) CFO/EBITDA quality: FY25 actual conversion 73.3% (CFO 5,806cr / EBITDA 7,922cr) held flat for estimate years given no confirmed WC drag -- PASS. (5) Estimates-vs-guidance variant view: stated explicitly (see F-EST-03) -- PASS (disclosed, not a failure mode). (6) Capacity-constrained revenue: metal volumes held near-zero organic growth (at rated capacity); alumina 5th-stream contribution capped by an explicit probability weight below full nameplate, never exceeding capacity x ramp -- PASS.

findings.title: Forward multiples at CMP sit above the 5-year historical P/E band
findings.detail: At CMP INR 361.65, base-case forward P/E is 11.04x (FY27E) and 11.65x (FY28E), both above the FY22-FY26 historical P/E band (min 4.61x, median 7.58x, max 8.66x, computed from fy_avg_price/eps_diluted). Only one international peer forward multiple was located in DR2 research (Alcoa, 10.04x), below NALCO's implied forward multiples; no domestic peer P/E benchmark was found (data gap). This context is provided for the downstream valuation agent only and is explicitly NOT a target price.
